narrative_purpose: The chapter's representative plate on the landing book-map: the hidden wiring of a forest revealed beneath the soil — a glowing web of fine fungal threads coupling the roots of many trees into one luminous circuit, the literal picture of 'the roots are all connected.'
subject: A dramatic cross-section of a Pandoran forest: above the soil line, the dark trunks and buttressed roots of several great trees rise into night; below the soil line, the earth is peeled away to reveal a vast, glowing lattice of impossibly fine fungal threads weaving between and linking the roots of every tree into a single shimmering network, brightest where many threads converge.
scene: A night forest in vertical cross-section, the underground half dominating: a dark soil volume threaded everywhere with a luminous mycelial web, roots descending into it like terminals plugging into cable.
camera: A wide cross-sectional view, eye-level with the soil line so both the dark forest above and the lit network below share the frame.
light: Bioluminescent key from the fungal web itself — cool cyan and teal light radiating from the underground threads, lighting the roots from below; the forest above kept dark and atmospheric.
palette: Void-indigo base, dominant Pandora cyan and living teal in the glowing underground web, the forest above near-black with faint planetshine.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, hand-painted texture, observed-from-life confidence, luminous and atmospheric.
detail_level: Crisp and intricate on the underground mycelial web and the root terminals; the forest above softer and dissolving into haze.
composition: Horizon/soil line low-to-centre, the glowing network filling the lower two-thirds, dark forest and negative space above for the plate to breathe.
consistency_notes: Na'vi absent; this is a landscape/architecture plate. Cool Pandora palette with from-within bioluminescent key. The establishing 'the forest is one wired circuit' mood that anchors the whole chapter.
